stem: After complete oxidation of a glucose molecules, ……… number of ATP molecules are formed.
note: The chapter never prints a total ATP yield per glucose. It gives only the conversion rates (3 ATP per NADH2, 2 ATP per FADH2, p14) and the glycolysis yield (2 ATP, p13); it does not state how many NADH2/FADH2 the Krebs cycle produces per turn, so the total cannot be assembled from the chapter alone. Printed 'a glucose molecules' is the book's own grammatical slip and is transcribed as printed.
